title: Network Flow
comment: Network Flow — Network flow problem is a specific class of linear programs that finds numerous applications (eg network, communication, optimal transport). On contrary to general LP, there are efficient cubic time simplex solvers. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Network_simplex_algorithm
alt_text: Network Flow. Network flow problem is a specific class of linear programs that finds numerous applications (eg network, communication, optimal transport). On contrary to general LP, there are efficient cubic time simplex solvers.

comment: Optim Manifolds — Classic reference: P.-A. Absil, R. Mahony, R. Sepulchre, Optimization Algorithms on Matrix Manifolds, 2008. Popularized gradient-based optimization on manifolds. https://sites.uclouvain.be/absil/amsbook/

title: Subdiv Curves

title: Fineup
comment: Fineup — Classic reference: J. R. Fienup, Reconstruction of an object from the modulus of its Fourier transform, 1978. Outperforms iterative projection for phase retrieval. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hybrid_input-output_algorithm

title: Fourier Meshes
comment: Fourier Meshes — 3D surface compression is achieved by projecting on Fourier-like atoms defined as the eigenvectors of the combinatorial Laplacian. http://www.cs.technion.ac.il/~gotsman/AmendedPubl/SpectralCompression/SpectralCompression.pdf
alt_text: Fourier Meshes. 3D surface compression is achieved by projecting on Fourier-like atoms defined as the eigenvectors of the combinatorial Laplacian.

title: 1D Dicrepancies
comment: 1D Dicrepancies — Various discrepancies between 1D probability distributions are derived from the cumulative function. They all share the good taste to control the convergence in law (thanks to the integration). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cumulative_distribution_function

title: Spirals

alt_text: Spirals. String art generates logarithmic spiral arcs by iteratively connecting equi-spaced points.

The Parzen-Rosenblatt window estimator approximates a probability density using a sum of kernel functions centered as the samples. This corr… https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kernel_density_estimation
alt_text: Parzen. Classic reference: E. Parzen, On Estimation of a Probability Density Function and Mode, 1962. title: Conditionals
comment: Conditionals — Conditional distributions defines a parametric collection of probability distributions computed from a joint distributions of two variables (here in the simple case of a density with respect to a product of measures). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conditional_probability_distribution
alt_text: Conditionals. Conditional distributions defines a parametric collection of probability distributions computed from a joint distributions of two variables (here in the simple case of a density with respect to a product of measures).

title: Dual Mesh
comment: Dual Mesh — The dual of a triangulation is defined by joining the centroids of adjacent triangles. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dual_graph

title: Kerner
comment: Kerner — Classic reference: Immo Kerner, Ein Gesamtschrittverfahren zur Berechnung der Nullstellen von Polynomen, 1966. The Durand-Kerner method is surprisingly simple way of computing all the roots of a polynomial. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Durand%E2%80%93Kerner_method

title: Aliasing
comment: Aliasing — Sampling a signal is equivalent to periodizing its Fourier transform. For non-smooth signals (with non-compact Fourier transform), it creates aliazing. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nyquist%E2%80%93Shannon_sampling_theorem
alt_text: Aliasing. Sampling a signal is equivalent to periodizing its Fourier transform. For non-smooth signals (with non-compact Fourier transform), it creates aliazing.

title: Fp Sampling
comment: Fp Sampling — The farthest point sampling is a greedy algorithm which asymptotically samples from a uniform density defined by a distance (e.g. geodesic). Defines a Delone set. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Farthest-first_traversal
alt_text: Fp Sampling. The farthest point sampling is a greedy algorithm which asymptotically samples from a uniform density defined by a distance (e.g. geodesic). Defines a Delone set.

title: Monge

title: Muntz
comment: Muntz — Muntz-Szasz theorem gives a sharp condition for lacunary polynomials to be dense. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/M%C3%BCntz%E2%80%93Sz%C3%A1sz_theorem
